description: TfL publishes taxi-rank locations from its Confirm records. The source says each TfL-appointed rank has a record and that the coordinate information originates from a rank-information spreadsheet. The dataset describes rank locations, not observed taxi availability, waiting times or passenger demand. It can supply facility locations in transport-access studies alongside the separately catalogued bus and rail assets. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
